items.title: Ernest Poree Interview, 1975-10-16
items.q: The interviewee confirms the interviewer's statement that 'She was with them. After Richardson left' and 'Richardson's got out of the union', but does not describe a personal interaction or professional relationship with Richardson himself.

ctx.x: Yeah, he did quit. But then, yeah. But all the rest of them died.
Just about everybody in the band. She was with them. Yeah, she was with them. After Richardson left.
